rooms.name: Entrance of a Narrow Pass
rooms.desc:
To the south you can pass between two unclimbable rock mountain faces. The
narrow pass there looks like it opens up into a treeless clearing.

rooms.name: In the Narrow Pass
rooms.desc:
Towering shale cliffs on either side of you seem to threaten an avalanche at
an moment. Even as you think it, a few pebbles tumble down as if brushed loose
by something high above.

rooms.name: In a Clearing
rooms.desc:
To the east and west, treacherous trails lead up the rocky slope and wind
themselves around the mountain which bars your passage south.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Trail
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow trail which rises sharply to the south. To the east the
rockly slope drops down into a grassy vale.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Trail
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow trail which rises sharply to the south. To the west the
rockly slope drops down into a grassy vale.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Trail
rooms.desc:
The rocky trail you stand on winds southward and drops sharply down to the
valley floor northeast of here. There's a fantastic view from this height.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Trail
rooms.desc:
The rocky trail you stand on winds southward and drops sharply down to the
valley floor northwest of here.  The view is fantastic from this height.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Ledge
rooms.desc:
The trail leads north here, and the slippery cliff face looks climbable above
you. A dark cave to the south echoes a cold howl of wind out it's dank opening.

rooms.name: On a Rocky Ledge
rooms.desc:
The trail leads north here, and the slippery cliff face looks climbable above
you. A dark cave to the south is almost no more than a deep niche in the
side of the mountain, but you can squeeze through. The sun can't quite
reach this slope, and a bitter cold wind sweeps into the links in your
armor.

rooms.name: Outside a Cave
rooms.desc:
The dark cave to the south looks very uninviting. Below you is a rough trail
leading down into a green vale.

rooms.name: On a Narrow Ledge
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow ledge, barely wide enough to place your feet 
side-by-side. With some difficulty you can climb down the rock face
here, or follow the trail south.

rooms.name: In a Dark Cave
rooms.desc:
This dusty cave is filled with cracked bones, some fresher than others but all
humanoid.

rooms.name: In a Dark Cave
rooms.desc:
This dusty cave is filled with cracked bones, some fresher than others but all
humanoid.

rooms.name: In a Troll Cave
rooms.desc:
This wide cave holds little furnishings except a bed of mats in one corner and
a long-extinguished fire.

rooms.name: Outside a Dark Cave
rooms.desc:
You stand outside a dark opening in the cliff face to the east. The trail
continues back out into sunlight north of here.

rooms.name: Inside the First Cavern
rooms.desc:
Sunlight gleams dimly in from the west. To the east a series of caverns glow
faintly with a green light that seems to be emitted by a spongy mold that
grows on the walls.

rooms.name: In a Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You stand in a narrow tunnel between two caverns. The walls glow faintly with
a green light, but nothing can be heard besides the clank of your armor.

rooms.name: In the Second Cavern
rooms.desc:
This cavern has a high ceiling that rises far out of the reach of your light
source. Narrow tunnels open to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Curved Tunnel
rooms.desc: This short passage has exits south and east, both leading into large rooms.

rooms.name: In the Third Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a large cavern. Passages lead out of it almost straight
across from one another, east and west.

rooms.name: A Curved Tunnel
rooms.desc: This short passage has exits south and west, both leading into large rooms.

rooms.name: In the Atrium
rooms.desc:
An absolutely gigantic cavern opens up to the east. You hear movement from
within, as well as the sound of rushing water.

rooms.name: In the Gigantic Cavern
rooms.desc:
This gigantic cavern is focused around two objects: a rushing waterfall of
pouring water that cascades through a pit in the floor, and a grotesque
throne made of humanoid bones.

rooms.name: Under the Waterfall
rooms.desc:
You stand under a rushing torrent of water, a deluge that sluices the mud off
of your armor and seeps through it to soak your skin.
